reference_profile: Same pinned font/MSXML profile as wine-font-resources-20261011; only cajfonts/HGBZ_CNKI.ttf replaced by the original control
hypotheses: Nominal coordinate scale stays 240/2473 PDF points per raw unit; no fit is permitted.
Nominal style em stays step*75/301 PDF points, with steps 28/31/35/42/48/63 and explicit axes 34/40.
Wine may round each repeated advance to an integer device pixel, unlike a PDF sequence of independent fractional origins.
Doubling the font advance without changing the outline distinguishes normal advance from nominal em repetition.
Changing zoom may change repetition count; such an observation forbids a universal correction derived from one screenshot.
additional_hypotheses: A single repeated Tj string may use a different PDF text-layout route than separate Tm origins; fixed clipping remains.
Original rectangle paths isolate glyph-raster sizing from fractional geometric origins. These do not change the declared physical placement model.
Measurements now predict native pitch=floor(nominal_em_in_device_pixels) at the four existing zooms. This is a tested display observation, not permission to calibrate PDF geometry to one zoom.
The standard permits integer-device-pixel constant spacing for TilingType 1/3. Their rounding direction must be observed, not assumed.
Type 2 distinguishes undistorted placement from constant spacing. All candidates retain the nominal em, raw endpoint, font resource and nonsemantic marking.
YStep=1000 em keeps other vertical tiles outside the original page; BBox is the authored marker em box, not a claim about arbitrary fonts.

Compare a normal one-em YStep and one-em-high paint strip using either the original font glyph or its identical authored rectangle. This distinguishes a sparse-tile limit from font-pattern support; neither is assumed.

Move the same cell scale from Matrix into BBox/XStep/YStep/content; a red unpatterned rectangle independently confirms ordinary page painting. The fiducial makes whole-page parity intentionally inapplicable to these diagnostics.

Explicit named/array Pattern color-space resources and uncolored patterns with a DeviceRGB base test whether the direct colored /Pattern cs route causes the missing painting. Ordinary red fiducials remain outside pattern operations.

marker_diagnostic.components: 8-connected; 1..79 pixels wide/high; x,y > 10; bands within 2 y pixels

strict_comparison: Exact full page-component RGB including border; no registration, resampling or column removal

limits: Device-pixel observations for the pinned profile; no authoritative physical-unit rule or per-document fit.
